item.title: James McGehee, Silas Hunt pave way toward integration at University of Arkansas
item.description: FAYETTEVILLE, Ark. (KNWA/KFTA) — The first-ever group of students admitted to the University of Arkansas included a Black man. James McGehee of Woodruff County, Arkansas, was one of eight students accepted into the Arkansas Industrial University's inaugural class in 1872.
